purpose: Read-only API interoperability and fixed-workload conservation probe; no new RTL, no optimization or full-network accuracy claim

target.flow: native optimized Tensor; coarse slang mapping for other components
target.storage: blackboxed generated memory leaves; bits separate
target.integration_scope: shared GPU fixed logic + standalone SM replication; estimated

sgpr_addressability.scope: measured RegFileBank ports; does not validate allocator behavior

implementation.sm_count: replication estimate; shared allocator/interconnect fixed at 2-SM baseline

missing: memory macro area, decoder/mux/periphery and timing inside blackboxed leaves
post-placement/routing, clock tree, pads and physical overhead
STA/common frequency validation; ABC delay target is not timing proof
power/activity energy model; external DRAM/controller/PHY cost
SM-dependent shared allocator/interconnect resizing
cost.source: shared fixed top + standalone SM mapped synthesis + measured component deltas

performance.state_policy: fenced tile dispatches; drain writes; invalidate written L1/L2 lines; retain read-only tags and L2 replacement state
limitations: Decoded timing excludes CTA/I-cache/host launch and invalidation scan cycles; 8-warp absolute timing remains unvalidated.

LayerNorm uses the paired ISA butterfly32 template for widths divisible by 32; other widths retain an unvalidated masked template. Relocated, concurrent and larger-width timing still needs RTL validation.
Polynomial exp, reciprocal and tanh GELU remain unvalidated software templates, not official compiled kernels.
Cache/MSHR and LDS response timing retain v5 abstraction limits; coherence fences are a declared software policy, not a translated RTL flush FSM.
Dispatch boundaries serialize batches by software contract; changing dispatch_tiles changes the program, not merely debug memory usage.
Full GPT-2 shape uses FP32 templates; no equivalence to a low-precision PyTorch backend or full-network RTL accuracy is claimed.

units.tensor_flops: multiply and add each count one
